content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD sponge-layer source file (header L1-44, Simplified BSD, FUNWAVE Development Team 2016). Seven subroutines: (1) SPONGE_DAMPING (L52-66, history 10/27/2010 Fengyan Shi) applies Larsen-Dancy(1983)-type damping by dividing ETA (only where MASK(I,J)>ZERO, L58-60) and U,V (unconditionally, L61-62) by SPONGE(I,J) over J=1,Nloc / I=1,Mloc. (2) ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC (L77-156, history 05/01/2014) generates incident waves inside a sponge zone: per Salatin et al. 2021 optimization (comment block L102-108) it precomputes BB=COS, CC=SIN time factors per frequency KK_sponge=1..NumFreq (L112-117; the commented originals L113-114 include Phase_Ser, the active forms L115-116 omit it), sums Cm_eta/Sm_eta, Cm_u/Sm_u, Cm_v/Sm_v Fourier coefficients into Ein2D/Uin2D/Vin2D (L121-130), optionally adds tidal boundary values TideWEST_ETA/U/V when TIDAL_BC_GEN_ABS (L131-136), relaxes Eta toward Ein2D weighted by SPONGE_TIDE_WEST(I,J) (L140; the older /SpongeMaker form is commented at L138, and U/V relaxation is commented at L142-143), recomputes fluxes HU,HV=(Depth+ETA)*U,V (L145-146), and exports Ein2D to tmp4preview (L154). (3) CALCULATE_SPONGE_MAKER (L165-213) fills SPONGE over the west strip only: Iwidth=INT(Sponge_west_width/DX)+Nghost (CARTESIAN L190, else DX(1,1) L192), lim=max(existing SPONGE,1.0) (L196-200), ri=R_sponge**(50*(I-1)/(Iwidth-1)) (serial L207; PARALLEL uses iista offset L204, ykchoi Jan/23/2018 replacing npx*Mglob/px L203), Sponge=MAX(A_Sponge**ri,lim) (L209). (4) CALCULATE_FRICTION_SPONGE (L223-395) builds a friction-type sponge CD field on all four sides: per side Iwidth from width/grid spacing (L272-274,297-299,331-333,360-362), distance ramp ri=MAX(0,REAL(Iwidth-...)) with PARALLEL iista/iiend/jjsta/jjend index forms (L280-286,305-311,342-349,371-378), coefficient tmp_2d_1/2=MAX(CDsponge*TANH(ri/10.0),lim) (L287,L312,L350,L379), sides merged by pointwise maximum (L317-325,L385-393); SPONGE here holds CD, comment L253-254. (5) CALCULATE_DIFFUSION_SPONGE (L405-580) is the same four-side TANH construction with diffusion coefficient Csp instead of CDsponge (L469,L498,L536,L565) and INTENT(INOUT) SPONGE seeded from existing values (lim=SPONGE if >0, L456-460 etc.). (6) CALCULATE_SPONGE (L591-767, history 10/27/2010) is the classic direct sponge: per side lim=max(SPONGE,1.0), ri=R_sponge**(50*(index)/(Iwidth-1)) exponent forms serial/parallel (L649-653 west, L677-681 east, L716-720 south, L745-749 north), tmp=MAX(A_Sponge**ri,lim) (L655,L683,L722,L751), pointwise max merge (L687-696,L755-766) with floor reset IF(Sponge<A_Sponge**(R_Sponge**50))Sponge=1.0_SP (L695,L763). (7) CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER (L778-936, history 04/27/2017) builds breakwater friction CD_breakwater: on the global grid (rank 0 under PARALLEL, L809-811) every cell with BreakWaterWidth>0 spreads tmp_2d=BreakWaterAbsorbCoef*TANH((BreakWaterWidth-ri)/(0.3*BreakWaterWidth)) over neighbors within radius ri=SQRT(((Ib-I)*DXg)**2+((Jb-J)*DYg)**2) (L826-849; loop bounds use Mglob+2*Nghost per gangfeng bug fix comment L831), keeping the pointwise max in tmp_glob (L842); under PARALLEL the global field is distributed by MPI_Gather of subdomain index ranges (Nista=iista+Nghost etc. L877-880, gathers L885-892) then mpi_isend/mpi_irecv slabs per rank (L897-925, ykchoi 28/Jan/2018 rewrite replacing the commented MPI_Scatter scheme L858-874); serial branch copies tmp_glob directly (L931). Preprocessor variants throughout: PARALLEL and CARTESIAN (scalar DX,DY) vs curvilinear (DX(1,1)).

verbatim_spans.text: !    SPONGE_DAMPING is subroutine for dampping waves using Larsen-Dancy(1983)
! note that I used SPONGE represent CD from input, do not mess up
! fixed bug from gangfeng 02/26/2021, should add 2*Nghost

unresolved: Din2D declared @L88 but never assigned or used anywhere in ABSORBING_GENERATING_BC (L77-156)

SPONGE_TIDE_WEST (L140), TIDAL_BC_GEN_ABS (L132), TideWEST_ETA/TideWEST_U/TideWEST_V (L133-135) are not in the USE GLOBAL ONLY lists L78-83 — presumably provided by USE TIDE_MODULE (L84); cannot be confirmed from this file
U/V relaxation commented out @L142-143: only Eta is relaxed toward the target (L140) while HU,HV are recomputed @L145-146 from un-relaxed U,V
commented BB/CC forms @L113-114 include Phase_Ser; active forms @L115-116 omit it — phase presumably carried in Cm/Sm coefficients, not verifiable here

dummy args R_sponge,A_sponge are declared but unused in CALCULATE_FRICTION_SPONGE (L245 vs body using CDsponge) and CALCULATE_DIFFUSION_SPONGE (L427 vs body using Csp); likewise depth,MinDepthFrc imported @L228,@L410,@L597 but unused in those bodies
exponent 50*(I-1)/(Iwidth-1) (L207,L653,L681,L720,L749) is integer arithmetic (I,Iwidth INTEGER @L186 etc.) — truncating division feeds REAL ri; relation across declaration and use lines
CALCULATE_SPONGE_MAKER handles only the west strip (Sponge_west_width, L165-213); no east/south/north branches unlike the other CALCULATE_* routines
scalar xx declared @L249,@L431,@L618 is unused in those three subroutines; a different allocatable xx(:,:) @L798 is used in CALCULATE_CD_BREAKWATER
SPONGEMAKER imported @L78 is referenced only in the commented line @L138 (SpongeMaker); active code uses SPONGE_TIDE_WEST instead
